Reference / net/interface

net/interface#

Immutable observation of one interface, supplied by a provider or a fixture.

Version: v1.0.0

Synopsis#

let addresses is @IpInterface=[IpInterface(IpAddress("192.0.2.7"),24)];
let interface=NetworkInterface("en0",2,addresses,true,false);
interface.addresses().first().string(); // "192.0.2.7/24"

Description#

Immutable observation of one interface, supplied by a provider or a fixture. Construction performs no device enumeration, existence check or configuration. Name is exact nonempty text without NUL; index is a positive system identity. The immutable address array preserves order, duplicates, host bits and prefixes. Empty address lists and down loopback interfaces are valid observations. Each value retains one snapshot; it never refreshes behind an observation.

SystemInterfaces is a separate, still-unimplemented enumeration capability.
